final_text:
Changes made
- Implemented transliteration of accented Latin letters and some ligatures.
  - Uses Unicode NFKD normalization + removes combining marks so é→e, ü→u, ñ→n, etc.
  - Adds explicit mappings: ß→ss, æ→ae, œ→oe, ø→o.
- Emoji and other non-Latin symbols are dropped.
- Underscores in input are treated as word separators (they don't become content; output separator still controlled by options).
- Added tests covering accented letters, ligatures, emoji, and underscores.

Files changed
- src/slugify.ts — added normalization, transliteration mappings, cleaning, underscore-as-separator handling.
- test/slugify.test.ts — added tests for the new behavior.

Notes
- The algorithm: normalize (NFKD) → strip combining marks → lowercase → explicit ligature mappings → remove any characters except a-z0-9, whitespace, dash, underscore → split on whitespace/dash/underscore → join using provided separator with the original truncation logic preserved.
- Ran tests: all tests pass (11 pass, 0 fail).

If you want more mappings (e.g., ł→l, ç→c) I can add them, but many of those are already handled via normalization.
